summary: Tested Auxiliar de Asistencia portal. Backend: 9/9 tests passed (login, my-scans-today, qr/scan access, admin regression). Frontend: Dashboard, Scanner, Mis Escaneos pages work correctly with proper navigation. ISSUE FOUND: auxiliar_asistencia can access /users and /asistencias pages directly by URL - should be redirected to their portal.

integration_issues.issue: auxiliar_asistencia can access /users page directly (shows 'Solo administradores pueden ver usuarios' warning but page still loads)
auxiliar_asistencia can access /asistencias page directly (full attendance module visible)

action_items: Add route protection in App.js to redirect auxiliar_asistencia from /users, /asistencias, and other admin routes back to /aux-asistencia
Consider adding a ProtectedRoute wrapper that checks user role and redirects unauthorized roles
critical_code_review_comments: Routes for /users and /asistencias don't check if user role is auxiliar_asistencia before rendering - they should redirect to /aux-asistencia
The /dashboard route correctly redirects auxiliar_asistencia to /aux-asistencia, but other routes don't have this protection

success_rate.frontend: 90% - Core portal works, but access restrictions incomplete

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auxiliar de Asistencia portal is functional. Dashboard shows welcome banner and 2 action cards. Scanner page uses QRScannerTab component. Mis Escaneos shows empty state with 'No hay registros aun'. Sidebar shows only 3 items (Inicio, Escanear Asistencia, Mis Asistencias). Header shows 'Aux. Asistencia' role label. ISSUE: User can bypass portal by directly navigating to /users or /asistencias URLs.
